name: a1_budget
description:
OBJECTIVE
    Ablation 1 (Sec. 7.1, Table 2) - EFFECT OF THE FARMER BUDGET.
    Vary the mean budget per hectare b-bar (Eq. 46) with every farmer's relative endowment (1+eps_i) held
    fixed, and track: solo feasibility, sum of solo values, coalition value v(N), pooled / private split,
    practice adoption (budget-hungry practices such as biochar can only enter when budgets allow),
    and the stability of the allocation rules.  The paper grid is 140/200/400/600 $/ha; lower budgets
    (0-100) are added because budget only binds when it is scarce.
